requirements.text: Define system KB architecture with diagrams/, components/, and flows/ as canonical organization.
Resolve large-doc warnings through architecture-aligned decomposition while preserving system semantics.
Choose YAML as canonical diagram storage and support future Pi TUI ASCII rendering from structured data.
Improve decision-loop UX with TUI row validation backed by wiki_diff_table.
Provide sprint/task final report mapping approved semantic rows to execution, validation, and Git proof.
Keep decision and planning as separate compilers while adding a read-only planning-impact preview to decision mode.
Use bounded runtime/agency automation and scoped parallelism only after planning validation; record platform_limited for unsupported worker execution.

accepted_decisions.summary: Canonical system diagrams use YAML under .codewiki/kb/system/diagrams; Mermaid is export/compatibility, HTML/SVG is not source truth.
system/components contains one Markdown file per architecture component that maps to source/file-structure ownership.
system/flows contains focused Markdown docs for intra/cross-component dynamics.
Large-doc warnings should be fixed by architecture-aligned decomposition, not arbitrary companion docs or exemptions.
Decision and planning remain separate compilers; decision gains read-only planning-impact preview.
Decision rows should be presented through a TUI table with per-row actions; chat is fallback.
Sprint/task final report should compare approved semantics to executed proof as closure view, not new truth.
Runtime/agency automation may be tested only through bounded planned tasks with explicit validation gates.

assumptions: YAML diagram specs can support future ASCII/TUI rendering more predictably than Mermaid or HTML canonical sources.
Existing component-map and file-structure-map contain enough initial component/source ownership refs to seed planning.
Current runtime worker execution may remain platform-limited; planning must not assume hidden session spawning.
non_goals: Do not implement the full system KB reorganization in decision mode.
Do not merge decision and planning compilers into one canonical loop.
Do not treat Mermaid, HTML, SVG, or generated ASCII as canonical source truth.
Do not use unbounded automation or hidden session spawning.
Do not claim large-doc warnings are fixed until planned implementation validates them.
risks: Medium semantic-system scope spans knowledge architecture, UI/UX, planning policy, and runtime/agency use.
Creating too many docs/tasks could over-fragment knowledge if planning lacks clear component/flow boundaries.
Runtime automation may expose unsupported worker execution; must record platform_limited rather than pretending success.
